summary: Kinetic Seas Inc., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement with CFI Capital LLC, issuing a $210,000 6% Convertible Redeemable Note with $21,000 OID, netting $189,000. The note matures July 8, 2027, is convertible at 60% of the lowest trading price (50% during DTC Chill), with a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap, redemption premiums of 105%-140%, and default conversion discount increase. This is a distressed financing arrangement, not a standard special situation. Watch for dilution and trading implications.
